name: NTT DATA
lede: NTT DATA is scaling AI in ANZ through its Sydney Innovation Centre and its University of Melbourne partnership. Airtable gives those cross-team initiatives one shared operating layer.
why_p: New innovation sites, research partnerships and a global AI infrastructure push mean more initiatives, partners and stakeholders to keep in step.

signals.title: Innovation Centre Australia opens in Sydney
signals.body: NTT DATA launched its Innovation Centre Australia at Darling Park, one of 11 globally, spanning six technology areas including physical AI and digital twins.
signals.angle: Run co-creation projects with clients, universities and startups from one connected pipeline.

signals.title: Expanding AI infrastructure ambitions
signals.body: NTT DATA set out plans to grow beyond traditional IT services, with AI-native services and data centre expansion as principal growth engines.
signals.angle: Coordinate infrastructure and service programs across regions with shared status and owners.

signals.title: Strategic partnership with the University of Melbourne
signals.body: NTT DATA signed an MoU with the University of Melbourne covering joint research, with AI, cybersecurity and quantum as priority areas and a Parkville innovation hub.
signals.angle: Track multi-party research projects, milestones and talent programs in one place.
